notes: The official list has 14 doctoral programmes. Saved STEM records: physics (Doctoral Programme in Science, SciDoc, which covers the other physical, earth, maths, statistics and computing fields), biology (MaCS), biomed (Biomedicine, with neuroscience also listed) and environment (ELOISA). Not saved as separate records, because a record holds one programme per field: Drug Research, One Health, Multidisciplinary Research in Renewable Natural Resources, Clinical Research (its brain research strand is not separately recorded), and Population Health and Human Behaviour (its page rendered only the menu, so it could not be read). No engineering PhD appears on the list, so ece, mech, chemeng, civil and bme have no record. Data science is a topic inside SciDoc's computer science area, not its own programme. Autumn 2026 rounds (2-15 September 2026) have closed. Application fee and GRE rules are not on the pages reached; a doctoral right has no funding attached, and PhD tuition is free.
